SELECT account_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        MAX(amount) AS max_amount,
        MIN(amount) AS min_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
) AS account_summary
WHERE (max_amount - min_amount) > 12000;
